migrations.title: Signals in base classes, typed errors, session safety, table/form fixes
migrations.summary: BaseView/BaseForm state becomes signals and BaseView splits into read-only BaseView + AbstractEditableView; RecordForm stops mutating its input; login()/loginWithGoogle() return Observables; CRUD errors are SailApiError with errorDetail(); the 401 circuit clears dead sessions via the public sessionExpired(); logout clears all cached state; appdata failures surface instead of hanging; datetime-local, pagination, hidden-column and 2FA-QR fixes.
migrations.body_markdown: Cumulative upgrade from v1.1.9. ## What changed | Area | Before | After | |---|---|---| | `tables/base-classes` — base-state-signals (breaking) | BaseView/BaseForm/table components exposed plain mutable fields: records, displayedColumns, searchTerms, editableRecord, isNew, title, isReadOnlyMode, tabFields, searchColumns, dialogComponent. | All of these are signals (or computed). Read with call syntax — records(), editableRecord(), isNew() — and write with .set()/.update(). Manual ChangeDetectorRef.markForCheck() calls are unnecessary and removed. | | `tables/base-classes` — baseview-split (breaking) | BaseView carried abstract handleDelete/handleUpdate plus the dialog opener; read-only views had to stub them. | BaseView is the read-only listing surface (no abstract members); editing views extend the new AbstractEditableView which owns dialogComponent, addRecord/editRecord/deleteRecord and the abstract handlers. | | `tables/forms` — isreadonlybound-removed (breaking) | Templates bound [isReadOnly]="isReadOnlyBound" and handlers re-assigned this.isReadOnlyBound = this.isReadOnly.bind(this) to force OnPush refreshes. | isReadOnlyBound is gone. Bind [isReadOnly]="isReadOnlyFn" — a stable arrow property; signal reads inside isReadOnly() overrides are tracked by the invoking template, so mode flips re-render automatically. | | `forms` — recordform-immutable (breaking) | RecordForm mutated the bound [record] object in place. | RecordForm keeps an internal working copy and emits the full updated object via (recordChange); the input object is never mutated. | | `auth` — login-returns-observable (breaking) | BaseAuthService.login()/loginWithGoogle() subscribed internally and returned void; errors went to console only. | Both return Observable. Nothing happens until you subscribe; the error channel carries login failures for the UI. | | `services` — backend-error-type (breaking) | BackendService.handleError rethrew the string 'error occurred, see console log and try again'. | CRUD errors are SailApiError (extends Error) with .status, .problem (keel RFC 7807 ProblemDetail) and .response (original HttpErrorResponse). handleError(error: unknown) is bound-safe for overrides. The new errorDetail(err, fallback) util maps SailApiError / HttpErrorResponse / Error to a display message. | | `models` — decorator-rename (breaking) | sail exported IsString/IsNumeric decorators shadowing class-validator names. | Renamed IsSailString/IsSailNumeric (constraints IsSailStringConstraint/IsSailNumericConstraint). IsSailNumeric also rejects exponential notation. | | `models` — authsummary-removed (breaking) | The AuthSummary interface described the permission index's internal escaped-pattern shape. | Removed — the permission index is an internal detail (compiled RegExp) and no public API produces AuthSummary values. | | `auth` — sessionexpired-public (breaking) | No public way to react to a dead session; the interceptor only counted 401s. | BaseAuthService.sessionExpired() is public — the auth interceptor calls it (via lazy injection) when the 401 circuit opens or is found already open, clearing the session and routing to login?sessionExpired=true. | | `payout` — bank-info-provider-required (breaking) | defaulted provider to 'AW' and countryCode to 'CA'. | [provider] is a required input; the country default is the first entry of [countryProfiles]. No hardcoded provider/country can leak into user_bank_info. | | `services` — labelservice-camelcase (breaking) | LabelService.GetLabel/LoadLabels (PascalCase); GetLabel returned '' for missing keys. | getLabel/loadLabels; getLabel falls back to the key so missing translations are visible. | | `payout/payment` — payout-payment-styles-removed (breaking) | provider_onboarding, bank_info_form and user_payment_methods shipped styles: blocks (user_payment_methods leaked CSS globally via ViewEncapsulation.None). | No CSS ships, matching the rest of the library. Class names are unchanged. provider_onboarding and user_payment_methods now expose BaseAsync's loading()/errorMessage() instead of busy()/errorMsg(). | | `tables` — tablereport-composition (breaking) | TableReport extended BaseRestService and fetched via a hardcoded '/api/' prefix. | TableReport injects BackendService and uses its new report() method (honours RestURL.api_prefix and typed errors). Report state resets when apiName changes; an appdata refresh no longer clears typed parameters. | | `auth` — configurl-timing-fixed (behavioral) | BaseAuthService captured every REST URL in field initializers, so configureRestUrls() in a subclass constructor ran too late — URLs baked in host-less. A trailing slash on httpHost also broke interceptor matching (host//api/...). | URLs resolve lazily per request and the configured host is normalized. Constructor-time configureRestUrls() is now safe; module-scope calls keep working. | | `auth` — logout-clears-state (behavioral) | logout() kept the appdata cache, permission index, appdata replay and the authed route tree alive on the login screen; in-flight appdata responses could hydrate the next session. | clearSession() drops cache/permissions/roles/loginToken, bumps a session generation (stale in-flight responses are ignored), emits an empty menu state to live subscribers, and restores the pre-login route config. deleteAccount() clears the role too. | | `auth/services` — appdata-fails-loudly (behavioral) | A failed appdata load hung the app forever: guards never resolved and every BackendService CRUD call blocked silently. | getAppData() errors while nothing is cached; guards redirect to /login/local; BaseAuthService.appDataError signal exposes the failure; repeated 401s clear the dead session and land on login?sessionExpired=true. Circuit-open rejections are a 401 with error.code === AUTH_CIRCUIT_OPEN_CODE. The appdata cache is reactive: computed()s reading table metadata recompute automatically when appdata loads. | | `tables` — datetime-local-timezone (behavioral) | datetime-local fields displayed the UTC wall-clock labeled as local and stamped local input as UTC, shifting stored times by the user's UTC offset on every edit. | Display converts UTC ISO to local time; save converts local input back to UTC ISO. Name-suffix ('...Time') temporal guessing removed — only column metadata drives temporal handling. | | `tables` — tablelist-pagination (behavioral) | TableList silently showed the first 100 rows with no paginator and no sorting; stale search filters survived navigating to the bare list URL. | Server-side paging (default 25/page, mat-paginator when total exceeds 10) with per-page client-side sorting; bare-URL navigation clears filters; fetch/save/delete errors render in the view. | | `tables` — hidden-columns-enforced (behavioral) | DisplayMode 'H'/'S' columns still rendered in lists, child grids and search/lookup forms; per-table hiddenFields leaked into search URLs; column defaults became implicit search filters. | H/S filtered everywhere; buildSearchTerms honours tableOverrides.hiddenFields; search forms blank every seeded default. | | `security` — twofactor-qr-works (behavioral) | The 2FA setup QR never rendered (keel returns an otpauth:// URI; it was bound to ). | The URI is encoded client-side via the new 'qrcode' dependency (ships with sail). Optional: render appDataError in the app shell; handle the sessionExpired query param on the login page. 16. npm install pulls qrcode automatically. Pass [twoFactorEnabled] where the app knows the user's 2FA state. 17. Replace raw localStorage writes with acceptToken(). 18. Apps mounting keel's payout handler under a different prefix must override these via configureRestUrls. ## Breaking-change risk Compile breaks: signal call syntax in subclasses, AbstractEditableView for editing views, isReadOnlyFn binding, (recordChange) handling, .subscribe on login calls, SailApiError handlers, IsSailString/IsSailNumeric renames, removed AuthSummary, required [provider] on the bank-info form, LabelService camelCase, TableReport subclasses.
